The bet is now clearly behind. >> ★★ GRADE RECORD — RESOLVER 1 (June-2026 data), GRADED 2026-08-12, MIRRORED INTO THIS LEDGER 2026-08-22 (the grade lived in STATUS.md only for 10 days — DAEDALUS Production Review #4, 2026-08-17, correctly flagged that any ledger-reading tool saw ZERO grades on this row. LEG-1 GRADE, on the letter of the frozen spec: required June YoY BELOW the prior month AS PUBLISHED IN THAT SAME RELEASE -> +2.1% vs +1.6% = ABOVE -> LEG-1 NOT MET. If the Jul-data release (~2026-08-31) also prints > +1.9%, HOM-01 CLOSES MISSED EARLY and does not wait for the Aug-data resolver. ⛔ NO CONFIDENCE MOVE — any mark move is Will-gated. ⚠️ THE PRINT HAD BEEN OUT SINCE 2026-07-31 (Freddie index page, verbatim: "Posted on July 31, 2026: Latest data is for June 2026") — it landed HOURS AFTER the 7/31 20:30 ET check that correctly read the prior stamp, and the desk then went dark 12 days. Neither side erred; the release landed inside the check window. ⚠️ REVISION DISCIPLINE FIRED AGAINST MY OWN BASELINE, EXACTLY AS THE REGISTRATION ANTICIPATED: grading June +2.1% against the CARRIED May +1.9% would have read +20bps of acceleration instead of the true +50bps — same verdict, wrong magnitude, kill arithmetic done on a stale number. The spec rule ("grade on each release as-published") is what prevented it. ⚠️ YEAR-VERIFY EARNED ITS KEEP A THIRD CONSECUTIVE TIME: the same search returned CalculatedRisk "Declined in July; Up 1.4% YoY," which direct-fetch dates to 2025-09-02 (July-2025 data). Excluded. ★ NOTE THE INVERSION AND BANK IT: in July the stale article would have FALSELY CONFIRMED Leg-1; this month it would have FALSELY KILLED it. THE TRAP IS INDIFFERENT TO DIRECTION — ONLY THE DATE CHECK IS. ★ MECHANISM STATUS: the Realtor.com list-price lead is 0-FOR-1. List prices -2.4% YoY in May (steepest since 2017) did NOT produce a June close-price rollover; June ACCELERATED 48bps. One print is not a falsification, but the registered IF-MISSED clause (the series loses standing as a 60-90d HPI lead) is now LIVE and dated to 2026-08-31. Three independent nominal series — FMHPI +2.1%, Case-Shiller +1.1%, NAR median +2.0% — are all still positive into the resolver. THE BET IS BEHIND, stated now rather than at resolution. >> ★★ PRECEDENCE + BASIS RULED 2026-08-22, BEFORE THE ~2026-08-31 PRINT. ⛔ DEFINITION/ANNOTATION ONLY — ZERO LEVELS MOVED. FOUND BY DAEDALUS (Will-directed structure review, packet 2026-08-22, e6b60df7a); VERIFIED BY ME AT THIS LEDGER BEFORE RULING, not taken on the packet's word. THE DEFECT: for any July print J between +1.90% and June's ~+2.06% AS REVISED IN THAT SAME RELEASE, Leg-1 CONFIRMS (J below the prior month) and early-kill arm 2 FIRES (J > +1.9%) SIMULTANEOUSLY, and the spec did not rank them — while the kill's 'do not wait for the Aug-data print' forecloses the ONLY remaining test of Leg 2 (<= +1.0%). A ~16bp band on a series that moved 48bp in one month is not a remote edge. RULING (A) — THE EARLY-KILL OUTRANKS A SAME-PRINT LEG-1 CONFIRM: if the July-data release prints > +1.9%, HOM-01 CLOSES MISSED EARLY regardless of whether it also prints below the prior month. RULING (B) — THE PARENTHETICAL IS THE OPERATIVE TEST: '(both print > +1.9%)' governs; 'ACCELERATES' is a descriptive label, NOT a second independent condition. A July print that DECELERATES but stays above +1.9% FIRES THE KILL. ⚠️ BOTH RULINGS GO AGAINST THIS DESK'S OWN INTEREST AND WERE CHOSEN ON THAT BASIS. The alternative readings (Leg-1 confirm suspends the kill; the kill requires acceleration) each keep alive a prediction that is already arithmetically behind, and adopting either nine days before the resolver is precisely the goalpost move pre-registration exists to prevent (LESSONS.md:42; the CRL-03 treatment). COUNTER-ARGUMENT CONSIDERED AND REJECTED, RECORDED SO IT IS NOT RE-LITIGATED: 'a deceleration is not the mechanism being falsified, so Leg-1 should suspend the kill' is genuinely arguable. It loses on arithmetic — inside the band July sits ~90-106bp ABOVE the <= +1.0% Leg 2 requires, so CONFIRMED would need a ~100bp single-month fall, roughly 2x the largest monthly move this series has shown (48bp). The kill forecloses a path that is near-arithmetically dead: it costs almost no predictive content and preserves the discipline. RULING (C) — +1.9% IS FROZEN, NOT RE-LEVELLED; PROVENANCE ANNOTATED. The +1.9% kill line is the May-2026 print IN THE MAY-DATA VINTAGE; the June vintage revised May to +1.58% SA, so the line now sits ~32bp ABOVE the level it was built to represent. ⚠️ STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE IT CUTS MY WAY: freezing is the LENIENT direction — a lower line would fire the kill more easily. It is frozen anyway, because the pre-registration rule is DO NOT MOVE THE NUMBER, not 'move it against yourself'; a threshold that may be adjusted mid-flight whenever the adjuster can argue the adjustment is self-punishing is not a pre-registered threshold. Any re-level is a RETUNE and is Will-gated. NOT PROPOSED. CONSEQUENCE, RECORDED NOT FIXED: a July print of ~1.75% is an ACCELERATION against current-vintage May (+1.58%) — the exact mechanism the kill exists to detect — and it neither fires the kill nor blocks Leg-1. RULING (D) — BASIS IS SEASONALLY ADJUSTED (SA). The metric cell said 'headline YoY % as published' and never named SA or NSA. June printed +2.06% SA / +2.02% NSA and both cleared, so it did not bind — but at a +1.90% line a 4bp wedge decides the kill. SA is fixed because it is what resolver 1 was ACTUALLY graded on and what the spec's own named mirror (CalculatedRisk) quotes, and because HOM-02 already specifies SA. ⚠️ OUTCOME-NEUTRAL BY CONSTRUCTION: which of SA/NSA prints higher in July is unknown, so this fixes an ambiguity without selecting a result. ★★ THE FINDING WORTH MORE THAN THE FIX, AND IT REVERSES THE PACKET'S OWN SEQUENCING: (C) IS THE CAUSE OF (A), NOT A SEPARATE ITEM. At registration the two clauses were DISJOINT — with May at +1.9%, 'J below M' and 'J above +1.9%' could not both hold, and the grading sheet's decision table is built on exactly that assumption (its middle row, 'J >= M but J <= +1.9%', is the thin strip between them). THE SPEC WAS NOT AMBIGUOUS WHEN WRITTEN. It became ambiguous when the June vintage revised M down to +1.58% and opened a 16bp band between the clauses. ⇒ GENERAL FORM: ANY SPEC PAIRING A FROZEN ABSOLUTE LEVEL WITH A VINTAGE-FLOATING RELATIVE COMPARATOR DRIFTS INTO OVERLAP (or into a dead gap) AS THE SERIES REVISES BENEATH IT. The threshold is frozen; the comparator floats; NOTHING ANNOUNCES THE DAY THEY CROSS. This is not a drafting error and re-reading the spec cannot catch it — only re-evaluating the CLAUSE GEOMETRY at each revision can. ✅ STANDING CHECK ADOPTED: at every FMHPI print, BEFORE grading, re-test whether the kill line and the prior-month comparator still bound disjoint regions. ⚠️ ONE LEG OF THE PACKET'S REASONING DOES NOT HOLD, AND CORRECTING IT STRENGTHENS THE FINDING: DAEDALUS wrote that I 'already committed to the level reading when I graded arm 1.' I did not. June printed +2.06% against a May of +1.58%, so June BOTH accelerated AND printed above +1.9% — the June grade satisfies the direction and level readings IDENTICALLY and therefore commits me to NEITHER. ⇒ There was NO governing precedent, which makes ruling (B) MORE necessary, not less. ★ A THIRD SURFACE CARRIED THE DEFECT AND IT IS THE ONE THE OTHER TWO DELEGATE TO: reports/2026-07-24_HOM-01-grading-sheet.md's decision table states 'J < M -> Leg-1 CONFIRMED' and 'J > +1.9% -> early-kill arm' as separate ROWS, i.e. as mutually exclusive outcomes. STATUS.md and docket ROW21 both name that sheet as the fire-time instrument. DAEDALUS named PREDICTIONS.tsv and docket ROW21; the grade is actually PERFORMED on the sheet. All three now carry rulings (A)-(D). ⛔ NO LEVEL MOVED, NO CONFIDENCE MOVED (60% stands; any mark move is Will-gated), NO CAPITAL. The bet remains behind and these rulings make it MORE likely to close MISSED, not less. >> ★★ 2026-08-31 FINAL GRADE — RESOLVER 2 (July-2026 data): HOM-01 CLOSED MISSED (EARLY-KILL). BASIS-ROBUST: SA +2.31 and NSA +2.24 both clear +1.9% by >30bp, so ruling (D) did not decide the outcome. (b) LEG-1 (last chance), graded for the record: required J below M as published in this release → +2.31% vs +1.81% = ABOVE → NOT MET, 0-for-2. (c) LEG-2 never tested (July sits 131bp above the ≤+1.0% line). VINTAGE NOTE, RECORDED BECAUSE IT CUTS BOTH WAYS: this vintage revises June to +1.81%, BELOW the frozen +1.9% kill line — a kill graded on current-vintage figures alone would have lacked arm 1; the registered rule ('grade on each release's as-published headline figures') governs and was applied, AND the close is over-determined regardless: Leg-1 died on this same print and Leg-2 was ~arithmetically dead (needed a ~130bp single-month fall vs a series whose largest observed move is ~50bp).
